<!--
  Aegir Hotel · Pull Request
  EN: Fill every section. A PR with an empty checklist will not be reviewed.
  PT: Preencha todas as seções. PR com checklist vazio não será revisado.
-->

## 📋 Summary / Resumo

<!-- What does this PR change and why? / O que muda e por quê? -->

## 🔗 Related issue / Issue relacionada

<!-- Use a closing keyword so the issue auto-closes on merge. -->
Closes #

## 🧭 Type of change / Tipo de mudança

- [ ] 🐞 Bug fix
- [ ] ✨ Feature
- [ ] ♻️ Refactor (no behaviour change)
- [ ] 🎨 Styling / SCSS
- [ ] 🐳 Docker / dev-container / CI
- [ ] 📖 Documentation
- [ ] ⚠️ Breaking change

## 🌿 Branch / Target

- [ ] Source branch is `feature/*`, `fix/*` or `chore/*`
- [ ] Target branch is **`develop`** (only release PRs target `main`)

## ✅ Checklist

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes
- [ ] `npm run test` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` produces a clean `dist/`
- [ ] Docs updated (`README.md` / folder `README.md` / `CLAUDE.md`) — both EN and PT
- [ ] No secrets, `.env`, `node_modules/` or `dist/` committed
- [ ] Self-reviewed the diff

## 🖼️ Screenshots / recording (UI changes)
